scope: Mac-only user-facing Codex file selection and bookmark restoration
regressionsFoundAndCorrected: The checkpoint dictionary key persisted the full selected JSONL path. It now uses the fixed Codex source ID and a regression assertion rejects path leakage.
Bookmark restoration could be entered concurrently by app startup and the Sources view. Restoration is now serialized on the main actor.

verification.macOSBuild: Anchor macOS arm64 Debug build succeeded with CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO

signingBoundary.automaticLocalSigning: failed because Anchor macOS and AnchorSafariExtension require provisioning profiles
signingBoundary.adHocSandboxSigning: code signature verified but the process did not finish App Sandbox initialization
signingBoundary.conclusion: NSOpenPanel, bookmark persistence and restoration are verified without an iPhone or developer account; App Sandbox enforcement still requires a provisioned build.

limitations: The selected JSONL contains synthetic privacy-minimal lifecycle rows rather than real Codex conversation content.
The user-facing flow ran in an unsigned Debug app, so it does not prove sandbox extension issuance in a provisioned package.
Long-running observation and real Codex file rotation remain separate acceptance work.
